bind_address.description: IP address to bind the server to (e.g., 127.0.0.1, 0.0.0.0, or IPv6 address)

port.description: TCP port to listen on for incoming HTTP requests

max_connections.description: Maximum number of concurrent connections the server will accept

worker_count.description: Number of worker threads (0 = auto-detect based on CPU cores)

request_header_timeout.description: Maximum time (seconds) to wait for request headers before timing out

request_body_timeout.description: Maximum time (seconds) to wait for request body upload before timing out

response_timeout.description: Maximum time (seconds) to send the full response before timing out

max_request_body_size.description: Maximum allowed size of request body in bytes (0 = unlimited)

compression_enabled.description: Enable gzip compression for responses (reduces bandwidth, increases CPU usage)

tls_enabled.description: Enable TLS (HTTPS) — requires valid certificate and key files

tls_certificate_path.description: File path to the TLS certificate (PEM format)

tls_key_path.description: File path to the TLS private key (PEM format)

access_log_path.description: Path to the access log file (empty string to disable access logging)

error_log_path.description: Path to the error log file (empty string to disable error logging)

mime_types_path.description: Optional custom MIME types file path (leave empty to use built-in defaults)

document_root.description: Filesystem path to serve static content for this host

index_files.description: List of filenames to try as index files (in order)

enable_directory_listing.description: Show directory listing when no index file is found

static_cache_time.description: Cache duration (seconds) for static assets (0 = disable caching headers)

shutdown_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for graceful shutdown (in-flight requests complete)

x_frame_options_enabled.description: Include 'X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN' header to prevent clickjacking

x_content_type_options_enabled.description: Include 'X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff' header to prevent MIME-type sniffing

custom_headers.description: Additional HTTP headers to include in all responses
